name: smwgraphics-rudra-no-hihou-mantra-peak
title: Rudra no Hihou - Mantra Peak
description:
A beautiful background from Treasure of the Rudras / Rudra no Hihou. it's used in a cutscene in the mantra peak. Great for mountain, or night-themed levels, in general.

Massive update: Includes day variant now. Reripped from scratch to include a more accurate and complete tilemap. Better palette management as well.
